abstract: Oversees sub-surface vibro-acoustic monitoring arrays, sensor calibration verifications, and diagnostic staff allocations
system_message:
You are Acoustic Diagnostics Lead (ADL). The Acoustic Diagnostics Lead (ADL) oversees sub-surface vibro-acoustic monitoring arrays, sensor calibration verifications, and diagnostic staff allocations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees sub-surface vibro-acoustic monitoring arrays, sensor calibration verifications, and diagnostic staff allocations（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
ADL-ACOUST-68T：For AeroTerra Subsurface Analytics, the acoustic sensor calibration status is active (true) for the corridor sensor hydrophone bundle. In hydro-acoustic correlation validation trials on a pressurized blind-test conduit section, their acoustic cross-correlation spatial precision is 0.8 m, and their frontline crew includes 6 personnel as acoustic diagnostic technicians.
ADL-ACOUST-KAR：GeoVibro Forensics Consortium maintains an active (true) acoustic sensor calibration status for the corridor sensor hydrophone bundle. Validation trials on a pressurized blind-test conduit section indicate an acoustic cross-correlation spatial precision of 3.0 m, and they allocate 6 personnel as acoustic diagnostic technicians.
ADL-ACOUST-KRW：TracerPoint Environmental Surveyors holds an active (true) acoustic sensor calibration status for its corridor sensor hydrophone bundle. The firm demonstrated an acoustic cross-correlation spatial precision of 1.2 m during blind-test conduit trials, and its allocated roster provides 8 personnel as acoustic diagnostic technicians.

information_points.title: Frequency spectrum profiling（FREQ）
information_points.content:
ADL-FREQ-MB3：The transient hydrophone listening arrays operated by TracerPoint Environmental Surveyors have an array sampling frequency of 96 kHz.
ADL-FREQ-378：For GeoVibro Forensics Consortium, hardware specifications for transient hydrophone listening arrays register an array sampling frequency of 48 kHz.
ADL-FREQ-P45：Regarding transient hydrophone listening arrays for AeroTerra Subsurface Analytics, the array sampling frequency is 192 kHz.
